evidence.reason: The NUL-delimited `git ls-files --stage -z` records may contain filenames with embedded newline characters. Line 924's `(.+)$` uses `.` which does not match line terminators, so a tracked file such as `docs/line\nbreak.txt` fails the entry regex and throws `terminal foreign index entry unsupported` during settlement, even when that file is unrelated to the cancelled edit. This is an implementation defect in existing intended behavior; parse the filename up to the NUL boundary or use a newline-tolerant filename group.
